bugs.error_message: sanity schema extract: 'Node.js version >=22.12 required. You are running v17.8.0'; then tsc 'Module "sanity" has no exported member defineType' and cli-spinners/spinners.json 'Unterminated string in JSON'
bugs.root_cause: Shell defaults to nvm Node 17; studio node_modules was partially installed/corrupt (truncated files, missing sanity types).
bugs.fix: Prefix commands with PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.18.0/bin:$PATH and run `npm ci` in studio/.

bugs.error_message: Seed failed: read ECONNRESET (during Sanity image uploads)
bugs.root_cause: Transient network reset from the Sanity asset API mid-run.
bugs.fix: Re-run `npm run seed -- pages nav`; uploads are reused by originalFilename and docs use createOrReplace with fixed ids, so re-runs are safe.

bugs.error_message: Contact form always answers 'Formulieren zijn nog niet gekoppeld.' (503)
bugs.root_cause: The static-phase stub was left in place; the real route was still commented out under a 'SANITY —' marker. The wiring pass grepped for disabled pages/layout but not API routes, and the verification never submitted the form.
bugs.fix: Restored the real route (Mailjet, allow-list via FORM_QUERY, reCAPTCHA) with visitor messages from Interface text → Forms. Verified by POST: missing field → „Naam” is verplicht., unknown form → invalid, complete → notConfigured (no Mailjet keys).
